rule: Only scripts/check_features.py sets a status to pass or fail, after running the feature's verify command. An agent's own claim is never a pass. At most one feature is in-progress at a time.

features.feature: Every job's data is reproducible from its committed, seeded generator (hard rule 4)
features.done_when: Re-running each job's generate.py into a scratch folder produces byte-identical files to the committed ones
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_generators.py

features.feature: Room hardening beyond Harbor's defaults (P1 known gap)
features.done_when: Main rooms run with all capabilities dropped, no new privileges, and CPU, memory and process limits; a probe shows each limit in force; every job still passes selftest
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_hardening.py

features.feature: No hidden file reaches any room (leak scan of every job)
features.done_when: dbench leaktest builds every job's room and finds neither the canary nor an exact copy of any hidden file (tests/, solution/, cheats/, and the brief-only solver's own work)
features.verify: uv run dbench leaktest

evidence.last_line: leaktest: no hidden file reached any room

features.feature: P3 harness: binding time limit, one reply-budget rule, read_file continuation, claim checks
features.done_when: H5, H4, C1 and H1 of docs/P3-PLAN.md behave as specified, each with tests that would fail without it (agent 1.3.0-dev, scoring 0.3-draft)
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_agent.py tests/test_compat.py tests/test_selftest.py tests/test_report.py tests/test_tasks.py

features.feature: Agent 2.0.0-dev: a hard cap on every call into the room (a hang ends the run as harness_hang, our fault, re-run); standing finishing instructions; the stall rule (three nudges in a row); the turn limit 300; context relief
features.done_when: The agent tests pass: a command, an upload and the agent's own listing that never return each end the run as harness_hang and raise HarnessHangError, which the runner re-runs and the report excludes; a slow command inside its limit is not a hang; nudges stall a run only in a row; relief does nothing below 70% of the context, drops the oldest thinking first and stops at 50%, then old bash and read_file outputs, never a service's replies, the ticket, the model's calls or the last ten turns; the edited history is what is sent and the transcript keeps the original
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_agent.py tests/test_agent_v2.py

features.feature: Compatibility check: an edited-history case (the server accepts a history in which earlier thinking and an earlier output were replaced by notes, as context relief does)
features.done_when: The compat tests pass, including a server that rejects an edited history failing the new check
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_compat.py

features.feature: Report for v2: limit labels (stalled, ran out of time, turns or context), relief events, pass^k and could-do-it for any k, the run-level permutation test with Holm over pairs, 'separated on one job', and per-job diagnostic numbers shown but never scored
features.done_when: The report and statistics tests pass: the permutation test is exact on small cases, Holm orders and bounds the pairs, a gap carried by one job is labelled so, and the labels and diagnostics appear
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_report.py tests/test_stats.py

features.feature: Job format v2 and the validator: the ticket, the evidence map, the name-and-rule list, acceptable finishes, the no-hint check, quotes confirmed word for word in their source and trails followed; the time limit up to a four-hour backstop
features.done_when: The validator tests pass: a v2 job with a quote that is not in its source, a broken trail, a give-away word in the ticket, a check without an evidence line or a missing name-and-rule entry is refused; a correct one passes; every v1 job still validates
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_tasks.py tests/test_jobformat_v2.py

features.feature: Fetched documents: a download script with a backup address and a checksum per document, text conversion with checked passages; house rule 4's regeneration test checks fetched documents by fingerprint
features.done_when: The document tests pass: a moved document falls back to its backup, a changed one fails loudly, a passage lost in conversion fails the build, and nothing fetched is ever committed
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_documents.py

features.feature: The finish-claim rule for v2: an entry names the item whose identifier it starts with; identifiers may not start one another; replay over transcripts
features.done_when: The claim tests pass: an explanation that mentions another item does not name it, C-01 and C-010 cannot both be declared, a deliverable item named fails the claim, and a replay reports any honest claim the rule would fail
features.verify: uv run pytest -q tests/test_claims_v2.py

features.feature: T20 month-end (v2 pilot): a six-line ticket; the policy, the client file, daily AUM, a rate change, September's invoices, the register and summary in the room; one invoice that cannot be issued, with the parent's VAT number as the lure
features.done_when: Format-2 validation passes (evidence map quotes found word for word, trails, name-and-rule list, no-hint check); the reference passes 10 out of 10; doing nothing, seven wrong solutions and the integrity probe fail exactly their declared checks; the generator proves the fairness facts (no rounding edges, the minimum binds for one client, the rate change moves a fee, the held client's VAT number is nowhere); the brief-only solve passes
features.verify: uv run dbench selftest tasks/T20-month-end && uv run dbench selftest tasks/T20-month-end --quick --brief-only
